rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for someone who attends or attended the same school as you.

example.english: That person is my former schoolmate.
example.jyutping: go2 go3 hai6 ngo5 ji5 cin4 ge3 tung4 hok6

rows.note: Use this especially for a former student or when emphasizing that you attended the same institution.

example.english: They are a former schoolmate from our university.
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 dei6 daai6 hok6 ge3 haau6 jau5
